title: AppearanceFields
description: JSON Schema (Kottaby 2020-12) for the AppearanceFields Kottaby/published projection of the `appearance_settings` entity. Validates the 7 atomic brand inputs (colors per-mode, logoUrl, siteName, siteTitle, siteDescription, defaultColorScheme). Source of truth mirrored from `backend/types/appearance.types.ts`.

colors.description: Per-mode brand colors (decision #12). Each mode stores the two atomic brand primitives; MUI derives light/dark/contrastText via nativeColor + color-mix().

logoUrl.description: Absolute URL of the uploaded logo. Nullable when no logo is set.

siteName.description: Short brand name used in navbar + <title> template suffix.

siteTitle.description: Full title for <title> default + app header.

defaultColorScheme.description: Default mode for new visitors. Drives which mode's colors are copied into the published columns on publish.
